simple.meaning: שְׂעָרָה (sᵉʻârâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a hurricane.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׂעָרָה (H8183) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 9:17, with occurrences in Job, Nahum.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׂעָרָה (H8183) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׂעָרָה (H8183) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׂעָרָה (sᵉʻârâh) / H8183 is traced through Job 9:17, Nahum 1:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
